Allows requested screen reading, UI actions, and answer overlays while you use the voice assistant. No key interception or passive recording.

When enabled, the assistant can send visible screen text to OpenAI during your voice requests and perform requested UI actions. Password fields are excluded, but other private screen content may be included. Screen content stays out of local logs. Enable this only if you want these tools. You can disable the service at any time in Android settings.
Signed out locally. Remote revocation was not confirmed; disconnect this app in ChatGPT settings.
This device does not provide that settings screen.

Voice only: answers appear in an overlay and use system text-to-speech. After an answer, the microphone listens for an eight-second follow-up while the voice panel is visible. Silence clears the session.

For TV button mappers, launch the VoiceActivity component or send android.intent.action.VOICE_COMMAND to this app.

ChatGPT plan access depends on your account and OpenAI availability. System speech recognition may use the device provider’s network service if on-device recognition is unavailable.
